dom_match.text: 輸出形狀為(1, 12, 8)與(1, 4)：12是三筆各四格，4是三個候選加none。後三列應全為True。分支前兩個token相同，最後一個不同，可看成同一問題搭配不同候選；repeat_interleave複製的是唯讀材料，各候選沒有讀其他候選的特徵。none才彙整平均、最大值、分數與數量，所以候選重排只改各自位置。整筆搬動後，ID索引也跟著改，仍讀到B原來的材料。以零起算的筆索引計，B原在第1筆（第二筆），取1×4+[0,1,2,3]，也就是第4–7格；搬後在第2筆，改取第8–11格。tokens與M都沿同一組indices取出，才不會一邊拿B、一邊拿別人的記憶。

dom_match.text:
def choose_with_policy(logits, ids, owners, target, temperature, threshold):
    probabilities = (logits / temperature).softmax(-1)
    index = int(probabilities.argmax())
    model_choice = ids[index]
    confidence = float(probabilities[index])
    accepted = model_choice != "none" and owners[index] == target and confidence >= threshold
    return model_choice, (model_choice if accepted else None), accepted


ids = ["record-main", "record-other", "none"]
owners = ["A", "B", None]
print(choose_with_policy(torch.tensor([8.0, 0.0, -2.0]), ids, owners, "A", 1.0, 0.99))
print(choose_with_policy(torch.tensor([0.0, 8.0, -2.0]), ids, owners, "A", 1.0, 0.99))

records.label: rubric-boundary-mobile

dom_match.text: 本批正式rubric題的permission與ready都已知，0／1就是已知no／yes對應的數字；生成器拒絕用unknown建立rubric標籤。C-v2這個三分類介面未替缺欄另設none，因此不能由合法文字輸入推論它會正確拒答；19.25的C-v3才把rubric缺欄的none納入服務與驗收。
